== Description ==
Players Committee Set 0 slip of [[Firepower (V) (Virtual Set 0, March 2017)|Firepower (V)]] with the 12 March 2017 errata wording (“unless ‘moving through’ the location”), marked “E” at the lower right, as printed on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 0 sheet (Set-0.pdf, PDF created 30 May 2017). The printed label above the card is included; the art window is blank on the sheet.

== Source and credit ==
* Source document: Players Committee [http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Set-0.pdf], PDF page 3, slot 2 (top row, middle). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive] (capture of 4 July 2017; the PDF used, SHA-1 0405029314d705b15b9d5029c1a8df8a6e97602a, matches that capture's digest).
* Derivation: PDF page 3 rendered at 300 dpi (poppler pdftoppm), the card with its printed label cut out (pixel box 896,138–1656,1206 of the 2550 × 3300 render) and saved as PNG. Nothing else was changed.
* Publisher: the Players Committee, 2017. Original card imagery © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. Fair use: the image identifies the published card on this non-commercial fan wiki.
